cover letter

The University of California, Office of the President, is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be offered a salary at or near the top of the range for a position. Salary offers are determined based on final candidate qualifications and experience. The full salary range shows the growth potential for this position and the pay scale is the budgeted salary or hourly range that the University reasonably expects to pay for this position.
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
Minimum 8 years professional experience or relevant work experience
Demonstrated supervisory experience and conflict resolution skills to effectively lead and motivate others.
Excellent business and administrate analysis experience, including strong organizational and office management skills.

Ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes. Demonstrated working experience in organizing and establishing job priorities to meet deadlines. Proven ability to work under varying deadlines and ability to remain flexible as demands and priorities change. Able to tolerate frequent interruptions. Ability to evaluate and anticipate problems and recommend solutions.

Ability to use a high level of discretion and maintain all confidentiality. Ability to maintain confidentiality with demonstrated experience in utilizing good judgement and discretion when working with a variety of sensitive issues or confidential information. Ability to provide leadership in addressing complex and sensitive problems / matters.

Advanced knowledge of common organization-specific computer applications. Demonstrated experience with a wide range of software, including project management tools and spreadsheets, and word processing/presentation tools.

The Finance & Administration Manager will oversee the full suite of financial and administrative responsibilities, providing focused oversight of budget and finance coordination, personnel administration, and internal operations, and directly manage communication, events, office facilities matters, ECAS website presence, and other related matters. This includes developing and managing information, projects, and communications throughout ECAS with a high degree of autonomy. This position will report to the Director of Strategic Initiatives and have two direct reports.  Please note this is a hybrid position with three days a week or more on-site.  The position is located in Oakland, CA.

30% Budget coordination: Oversees a portfolio that includes developing and preparing budgets and regular financial reports, monitoring the budget process, tracking contracts and expenses, as well as managing new and recurring procurements, reconciliations, and large strategic funding requests.

30% Personnel coordination: Oversees a portfolio that includes partnering with UCOP human resources, labor relations, or external contractor vendors on personnel recruitment, retention, and other personnel-related matters.

30% Office Administration: Oversees a portfolio that includes scoping, planning, coordinating and prioritizing internal ECAS administrative functions: communications, training and events, and facilities. ECAS’ general communications program includes internal communications, listserv management, calendar management, and ECAS website maintenance. Training and events program includes internal and external training opportunities, hosting small internal events, as well as partnering with UCOP events to host large, off-site, hybrid events. Facilities program includes partnering with various UCOP facilities partners on the management and maintenance of ECAS’ physical space.
10% Other duties as assigned.
Familiarity with compliance and audit principles, theories and systems of internal control, and compliance standards.
Familiarity with compliance regulatory requirements related to ECAS portfolio, audit and investigations program principles.
Understanding of Ethics, Compliance and Audit Services mission and the sensitive nature of the office.
10% Travel to national conferences/training events
Finance & Administration Manager
Benefits: For information on the comprehensive benefits package offered by the University visit: Benefits of Belonging

Demonstrated financial, budgetary and analytical skills. Demonstrated ability to prepare basic financial reports. Familiarity with accounting principles and budgeting procedures. Knowledge of financial analysis and reporting techniques; human resources policies and risk management planning.

Advanced knowledge of the organization's processes, protocols and procedures with a focus on budget and resource management and personnel policy. Broad knowledge of higher education governance, organizational and personnel structures, communication channels, policies and procedures. Broad knowledge of the University's administrative structure and functions, policies, procedure and practices is preferred.
Familiarity with the University ethics, compliance policies, procedures and programs. Ability to apply compliance concepts and in the completion of assignments is a plus.

Strong analytical / problem-solving skills. Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to analyze situations, identify existing or potential problems and recommend solutions. Demonstrated ability in researching, analyzing and synthesizing information in order to provide succinct summaries and relevant facts/issues.

Strong skills to communicate and influence effectively with all levels of staff, faculty, alumni / donors, students and external constituents, both verbally and in writing. Demonstrated outstanding oral and written communication skills to communicate with a diverse population using diplomacy, flexibility and tact. Demonstrated skill in communicating issues clearly and gathering information through appropriate consultation with a wide variety of constituents. Ability to work with diverse populations at all levels of the organization.
